# A sheet using every block, for a project that is not memo, so the renderer is seen to take nothing from memo.
title Kiln, on one sheet

actor maker  amber   the potter
actor oven   cyan    the kiln
actor log    green   the firing log
actor shelf  violet  the store room

line arrow work moves
line dotted @log reads or writes the log
line planned @log planned
mark balloon part
mark flag asked of a studio
mark diamond @maker your attention

::: titleblock
cell id | 1 · Premise · sheet 1 of 1
wordmark kil@log{n}
motto Fire it once
para A kiln, `kiln`, with a log.
cell problem | Problem — without kiln
lead Pots crack:
point P1 | Nobody knows the last firing. | {1} ▲1
point P2 | Shelves overflow: `kiln ls | wc`. | {2}
cell answer | Solution — with kiln
big The @shelf{store room} keeps pots; @log{the log} keeps firings.
para **What happened:** each firing.
cell attn | Your attention goes here
item ◆1 | **Loading:** what goes in.
:::

view 2 WORKFLOW | one firing | a lane for each actor
```svg
<svg width="10" height="10"><rect class="bx oven"/></svg>
```

::: swimlane
lane @maker
lane @oven | the kiln | itself
lane @log
phase 1 | LOAD
phase 2 | FIRE
box load @maker 1.1-2 | **load the kiln** ◆1 | `kiln load`
text @maker 2 | or wait for | a full shelf
box heat @oven 1.2 chip | `kiln heat`
box pots @oven 2 stack | **a firing** | ×N, one by one ▲1
box entry @log 1.1-2 | FIRING LOG | {1} the last firing
box alarm @log 2 planned | an @log{alarm}
box bell @log 2 note | rings when | it cracks
arrow load entry
arrow load heat
arrow heat pots
arrow pots heat dotted
arrow entry alarm planned
arrow alarm bell
detail A | pots alarm
:::

::: details
detail A | Detail A — when a pot cracks | **the log refuses** a guess.
rung @oven | 1 · Cool | the kiln itself | It cools slowly.
rung @log planned | 2 · Alarm | the log's own bell | It rings.
notes | General notes — what the kiln asks of a studio
note 1 | `vent` stays open. | Always.
foot Each flag marks where its note applies.
:::

view 3 SYSTEM | the pieces | balloons key the drawing
::: assembly
person potter @maker A1-A2 | POTTER | at the wheel
box kiln @oven B1 | KILN | `kiln fire` | [C6][C10] | 📄 cone chart
box pots @oven B2 stack | **a firing** | ×N, one by one
group room @shelf C1-C2 | STORE ROOM ▲1
box shelf @shelf C1 planned | SHELF {2} | a rack
box cart @shelf C2 | CART | on wheels
rail belt @shelf D1-D2 | BELT
valve check @oven | ▲1
store log @log B3-C3 | FIRING LOG {1} | one file per kiln | [FIRINGS] [GLAZES]
arrow potter kiln
arrow potter pots
arrow kiln shelf planned
arrow pots cart
arrow cart belt via check
arrow room log dotted
arrow log potter @oven | read back | before the next load
parts PARTS LIST | what the kiln is made of
part 1 @log | The log | one file per kiln | Firings outlive the potter.
part 2 @shelf planned | The `shelf` | a rack | Pots wait.
:::

view 4 HOW-TOS | what a potter types | real output
::: spec
column
howto 4.1 | Fire a load | `kiln fire` @maker or ask `helper` @oven
caption It fires **once**.
```term beside
$ kiln fire -cone 6
```
caption Beside the terminal.
column
howto 4.2 | Read the log | `kiln log <id>` @maker
```term
$ kiln log a88
firing {i:a88}  {ok:done}  cone 6
  note {h:4e72a67} <hot> & \{x}
       cracked {q:Why?} {a:a)}
```
more The log **keeps** each firing.
more It is never pruned.
:::
